ModMetaData.name: World Tile Scouting
ModMetaData.author: local
ModMetaData.description: After ground-penetrating scanner research, remotely scout enemy settlements, work sites, and inhabited camps on the world map. After one day you get an expected roster summary (ranged/melee mix, armor tags, weapon categories) derived from faction/PawnKind data — not a live map ESP. Intel persists until raid/attack, roster fingerprint change, or expiry. Does not hard-depend on Odyssey or other DLC.
